name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 22.9 on 16 Nov and the S&P 500 5.2% below its high, inside both Watch bands
state: The VIX closed near 22.9 on 16 Nov, up 18% on the week and above the 20 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended at about 7,417, 5.2% below its 52-week high of 7,819, crossing the 5% drawdown line; its worst day of the past five sessions was a 1.9% fall. No VIX reading above 30 or circuit breaker was recorded.
for_you: Equity-linked savings and pensions can see larger day-to-day swings in a Watch regime. Volatility at these levels has historically been common and is not by itself a sign of a crash.
rubric_hit: VIX 23.3 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 5.15% ≥ 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
